text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm walking through the central
plaza...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hm, hm, hmm! ♪ What am I g'nna have
for
dinner? ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe! Give me a deep bow!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oka—
Fwoosh!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waah?! Uh, did something go right by
me—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, stay on your toes! Now turn around!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-okay!
Fwooosh!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! S-something is zooming around
me, I just
know it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There's more where that came from.
Next, take a
step to the right!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-okay!
Fwooosh!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And to wrap things up... pose like an
idol and
give me your best catchphrase!
Now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: An idol?! Ohhh, ummm!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm your sup'r idol, Spe! Zing! ☆
Fwip, fwip! Thwomp!
GAAAAAHHHHH!
Thud!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-what was that?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Phew, you were in quite the sticky
situation, Spe.
But everything's A-OK
now! Case closed! ☆

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, Sei! What was that just now?!
I'm certain I
heard a weird noise,
followed by someone
shrieking...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hold on... Golshi's passed out?! And
she's covered
in goop?! What's
happenin'?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, here's a quick rundown.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was just on my little meander, nothing
special.
And there Golshi was, with her
sights set on you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right... Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And what does Golshi have? A bunch of
mud
boomerangs! Escape your turmoil,
Spe! To the
right, to the left!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So that's why you had me turning and moving around!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup, and all of the boomerangs came
flying right
back at Golshi. Womp,
womp.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, because they're boomerangs... That
makes
sense. So you made me pose for a
reason too,
right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, I just wanted to see you pose. That's
all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
WHAAAAAT?! I c-can't believe I did
that...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But you did really help me out there...
So, thank
you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What an honest little cupcake you are. I
just
happened to be watching from the
sidelines,
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Welp, that should be the last of your
questions.
Wanna head back?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sure. Um... is it okay to leave Golshi
here
unconscious?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Golshi's a tough cookie! She's fiiine...
Probably! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
SPEEEE ANNDD... SKYYY? Hi, how ya
doing? ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, she's awake.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Guess we've got no choice but to book
it! Let's
go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaargh?! H-hey! Wait for me, Sei!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
BWAHAHA! I'll give you both a mud
makeover,
free of charge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week panics and quickly follows
Seiun
Sky's lead...
